about.title: Hi! I'm Marta.
about.text:
I've always been fascinated by stories that bring people together, no matter the language they're told in. 
 That's what led me to study Translation and Interpreting. Along the way, I realised that effective communication goes far beyond translating words—it's about understanding people, context and the intention behind every message. 
 Today, I combine that perspective with content creation, localisation and multilingual SEO to help brands communicate naturally across languages and markets. 
 I enjoy working where creativity meets strategy: observing, analysing and finding the best way for every message to preserve its essence, wherever its audience may be.

A space where creativity, languages and real stories come together.

hero.backgroundLabel: What it says → Translation \n How each audience understands it → Localisation \n How people find it → SEO
hero.title: From Content to Conversion
hero.text:
Adapting a message is about more than translating words. It's about making sure it continues to resonate, wherever its audience may be. 
 Every language has its own nuances, every market its own context, and every brand its own voice. 
 I help businesses adapt and optimise their content to reach new markets, improve their search visibility and communicate naturally across languages. 
 By combining translation, localisation and multilingual SEO, I create content that preserves its purpose, connects with the right audience and has real potential to perform in Google Search. 
 My goal is simple: to make every piece of content feel as though it were originally created for its target market.
hero.availability: Available for freelance projects, one-off collaborations and ongoing editorial support.
